ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMPLOYMENT_CCD] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment AS
(
	   SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT
    BCM.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,HASHBYTES('MD5', BCM.CUST_EMP_NAME) AS EmployerId
	,BCM.CUST_OCC_CODE AS JobTitleId
	,BCM.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,BCM.CUST_ANN_SALARY AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,BCM.CUST_EMP_TYPE AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,BCM.CUST_OCC_PER AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,BCM.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM  BUSC.CCD_MCUSTOMER BCM
	WHERE BCM.isLatest = 1

UNION

SELECT
    BCD.CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
	,HASHBYTES('MD5', BCD.CUST_EMP_NAME) AS EmployerId
	,BCD.CUST_OCC_CODE AS JobTitleId
	,BCD.CUST_DATE_MAINT AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,BCD.CUST_ANN_SALARY AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,BCD.CUST_EMP_TYPE AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,BCD.CUST_OCC_PER AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,BCD.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CCD_DCUSTOMER BCD
	WHERE BCD.isLatest = 1
	   )A
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment WHERE RN = 1;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmployerId
,JobTitleId
,EmployerRelationshipTypeId
,EmployeeId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodStartDate))
,AnnualSalaryAmount
,EmploymentClassificationId
,PeriodOfOccupation
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId,EmployerRelationshipTypeId,EmployeeId,FinancialInstitutionId,Sourcecode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerId
,EmployerId
,JobTitleId
,EmployerRelationshipTypeId
,EmployeeId
,convert(date,convert(varchar,PeriodStartDate))
,convert(int,AnnualSalaryAmount)
,EmploymentClassificationId
,PeriodOfOccupation
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerId,EmployerId,JobTitleId,EmployerRelationshipTypeId,EmployeeId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment WHERE SourceCode = 'CCD' AND PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerId,TGT.EmployerId) AS EmployerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.JobTitleId,TGT.JobTitleId) AS JobTitleId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerRelationshipTypeId,TGT.EmployerRelationshipTypeId) AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,TGT.EmployeeId) AS EmployeeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SOURCECODE,TGT.SOURCECODE) AS SOURCECODE
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE' 
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND convert(varchar,SRC.EmployerId) = convert(varchar,TGT.EmployerId)
AND SRC.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmployerRelationshipTypeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmployerRelationshipTypeId,'')
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmployeeId,'')
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SOURCECODE = TGT.SOURCECODE
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId AND DELTA.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId AND DELTA.EmployerRelationshipTypeId = TGT.EmployerRelationshipTypeId AND DELTA.EmployeeId = TGT.EmployeeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId AND SRC.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId AND SRC.EmployerRelationshipTypeId = TGT.EmployerRelationshipTypeId AND SRC.EmployeeId = TGT.EmployeeId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL


---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment  ( 
	CustomerId
	,EmployerId
	,JobTitleId
	,PeriodStartDate
	,PeriodEndDate
	,EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,AnnualSalaryAmount
	,EmploymentClassificationId
	,EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,EmploymentStatusId
	,EmploymentNote
	,EmployeeId
	,NatureOfIncome
	,PeriodOfOccupation
	,SourceCode
	,FinancialInstitutionId
	,WorkFlowId
	,TaskRunId
	,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
	SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,SRC.JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,NULL AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,SRC.AnnualSalaryAmount
	,SRC.EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,NULL AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,NULL AS EmployeeId
	,NULL AS NatureOfIncome
	,SRC.PeriodOfOccupation AS PeriodOfOccupation
	,'CCD' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId AND DELTA.EmployerId = SRC.EmployerId AND DELTA.JobTitleId = SRC.JobTitleId AND DELTA.EmployerRelationshipTypeId = SRC.EmployerRelationshipTypeId AND DELTA.EmployeeId = SRC.EmployeeId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
 

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;


END

ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMEREMPLOYMENT_CRM] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment AS (
	SELECT 
		BCA.ORGKEY AS CustomerId
		,HASHBYTES('MD5',BCM.STRTEXT4)  AS EmployerId
		,BCM.STRTEXT2 AS JobTitleId
		,BCM.DTDATE1 AS PeriodStartDate
		,BCM.STRTEXT9 AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
		,NULL AS AnnualSalaryAmount
		,NULL AS EmploymentClassificationId
		,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
		,BCD.EMPLOYMENT_STATUS AS EmploymentStatusId
		,NULL AS EmploymentNote
		,BCA.STAFFEMPLOYEEID AS EmployeeId
		,BCD.INCOME_NATURE AS NatureOfIncome
		,'CRM' AS SourceCode
		,BCA.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
	FROM BUSC.CRM_ACCOUNTS BCA
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT STRTEXT2,DTDATE1,STRTEXT9,STRTEXT4,ORGKEY,BANK_ID,TYPE,DEMOGRAPHICID,isLatest FROM  BUSC.CRM_MISCELLANEOUSINFO) BCM  ON BCM.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY AND BCM.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID  AND BCM.isLatest = 1  
	LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT EMPLOYMENT_STATUS,INCOME_NATURE,EMPLOYERID,ORGKEY,BANK_ID,DEMOGRAPHICID,ACCOUNTID,isLatest FROM  BUSC.CRM_DEMOGRAPHIC) BCD  ON BCD.ORGKEY = BCA.ORGKEY  AND BCD.BANK_ID = BCA.BANK_ID  AND BCD.isLatest = 1 AND BCD.DEMOGRAPHICID = BCM.DEMOGRAPHICID
	WHERE BCM.TYPE = 'CURRENT_EMPLOYMENT'   AND BCD.ACCOUNTID <> 0 and BCA.isLatest = 1

)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmployerId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobTitleId),
	CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartDate),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmploymentPositionTypeId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmploymentStatusId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmployeeId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,NatureOfIncome),FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,EmployerId
		,JobTitleId
		,EmploymentPositionTypeId
		,EmployeeId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
	FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment 
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT AS (
	SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmployerId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,JobTitleId), 
	CONVERT(DATE,PeriodStartDate),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmploymentPositionTypeId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmploymentStatusId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,EmployeeId),
	CONVERT(VARCHAR,NatureOfIncome),FinancialInstitutionId)) AS HASHROW
		,CustomerId
		,EmployerId
		,JobTitleId
		,EmploymentPositionTypeId
		,EmployeeId
		,FinancialInstitutionId
		,SourceCode
	FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment 
	WHERE SourceCode = 'CRM' AND (PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31')
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerId,TGT.CustomerId) AS CustomerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployerId,TGT.EmployerId) AS EmployerId
	,ISNULL(SRC.JobTitleId,TGT.JobTitleId) AS JobTitleId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId,TGT.EmploymentPositionTypeId) AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,TGT.EmployeeId) AS EmployeeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceCode,TGT.SourceCode) AS SourceCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
AND SRC.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'')
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmployeeId,'')
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW  OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, SRC.PeriodStartDate))
FROM BNKM.CustomerEmployment TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId
AND DELTA.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
AND DELTA.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId
AND ISNULL(DELTA.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'')
AND ISNULL(DELTA.EmployeeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmployeeId,'')
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
 AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId 
AND SRC.EmployerId = TGT.EmployerId
AND SRC.JobTitleId = TGT.JobTitleId
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'')
AND ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,'') = ISNULL(TGT.EmployeeId,'')
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceCode = TGT.SourceCode
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL or TGT.PeriodEndDate = '9999-12-31'



---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerEmployment(
	[CustomerId]
	,[EmployerId]
	,[JobTitleId]
	,[PeriodStartDate]
	,[PeriodEndDate]
	,[EmploymentPositionTypeId]
	,[AnnualSalaryAmount]
	,[EmploymentClassificationId]
	,[EmployerRelationshipTypeId]
	,[EmploymentStatusId]
	,[EmploymentNote]
	,[EmployeeId]
	,[NatureOfIncome]
	,[SourceCode]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT
Distinct
     SRC.CustomerId AS CustomerId
	,SRC.EmployerId AS EmployerId
	,SRC.JobTitleId AS JobTitleId
	,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS PeriodEndDate
	,SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId AS EmploymentPositionTypeId
	,NULL AS AnnualSalaryAmount
	,NULL AS EmploymentClassificationId
	,NULL AS EmployerRelationshipTypeId
	,SRC.EmploymentStatusId AS EmploymentStatusId
	,NULL AS EmploymentNote
	,SRC.EmployeeId AS EmployeeId
	,SRC.NatureOfIncome AS NatureOfIncome
	,'CRM' AS SourceCode
	,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
	, 0 AS WorkFlowId
	, 0 AS TaskRunId
	,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA DELTA
 ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId
 AND DELTA.EmployerId = SRC.EmployerId
 AND DELTA.JobTitleId = SRC.JobTitleId
 AND ISNULL(DELTA.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'') = ISNULL(SRC.EmploymentPositionTypeId,'')
 AND ISNULL(DELTA.EmployeeId,'') = ISNULL(SRC.EmployeeId,'')
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
 AND DELTA.SourceCode = SRC.SourceCode
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerEmployment_DELTA;

END
